denied.title: Camera is off
denied.body: The app has no camera permission, so it cannot film live. Turn it on and tap “Try again”, or import a slow-motion video instead.
denied.how: How to turn the camera on
denied.ios2: Choose Safari › Camera (Home Screen app: choose Golf Swing Lab)
denied.ios3: Set it to “Allow”, come back and tap “Try again”
denied.other1: Tap the lock or camera icon next to the address bar
busy.title: Camera is in use
busy.body: Another app (for example a video call or the Camera app) is using the camera. Close it and tap “Try again”.
missing.title: No camera found
missing.body: This device or browser has no usable camera. You can import a slow-motion video recorded on another phone.
